title: Discover a project's default branch through Git

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage for SEED-437

**Verdict. Caught.** The maintained Add Project browser test caught a regression that made the Board ask for the checkout branch instead of the branch origin advertised.

## Promise and fault

`SEED-437#discover-project-default-branch-through-git` at `4521779988ffd9027b3663e49683ad7224689e00` promises that Add Project configures the branch advertised by origin's symbolic `HEAD` even when the execution checkout tracks a different branch. The [story](.planning/seeds/SEED-437-discover-project-default-branch-through-git.md#discover-project-default-branch-through-git) and plan 843 identify the distinguishing example. The fixture advertises `release+stable` and clones a checkout tracking `origin/local-checkout` at a different commit. The case verifies both facts before Add. [Fixture](dashboard/test-support/support/projectAddMachine.ts#L21), [browser case](e2e/configuration/project-add.spec.ts#L47)

In a detached scratch worktree, I changed the assignment of the configured ref to use `git branch --show-current` in the selected execution checkout after successful origin discovery. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged. [Production entry point](dashboard/server/projectAddition.ts#L66), [fault diff](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/fault.diff)

## Observation and restoration

Locked dependency installation and pinned Chromium readiness passed. Each run selected one Chromium case using one worker on AC power.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/configuration/project-add.spec.ts --grep 'launches in its execution checkout and survives restart' --workers=1 --trace on
```

- Baseline passed. [Runner record](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/baseline.json)
- With the fault, the recorded browser POST to `/__project-configuration/add` returned HTTP 200 for `example/sample-app` with `project.ref` set to `local-checkout`. The trace response body supplies this observation independently of the test's assertion. [Network observation](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/fault-network-observation.json), [trace archive](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/fault-trace.zip)
- The faulted run failed at the Board request assertion. It expected `commits/release%2Bstable` and observed a request for `commits/local-checkout`. The assertion failed before the test read the settings file or restarted the Dashboard. [Maintained assertion](e2e/configuration/project-add.spec.ts#L63), [fault log](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/fault.log)
- I restored the edited file byte for byte and matched the pre-probe Git status. The same selected case passed on restored code. I removed the scratch checkout and verified its path and Git registration were gone. [Restored runner record](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-437.Q8q0Ud/restored.json)

**Next proof action.** Keep the maintained assertion. This check supplies no evidence requiring stronger proof or a new follow-up.

**Prior disposition.** The result supports the existing slice 1 proof for the Board request after Add. The injected fault left the restart and retry paths outside the verdict.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** Measured by Playwright runner records as 22.27 s baseline, 9.75 s faulted, and 12.71 s restored, totaling 44.73 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because no separate human-effort measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because the host supplies no separate agent-effort measurement for this check.
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 176250 ms (measured), from 1795619790688 to 1795619966938 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked `4521779988ffd9027b3663e49683ad7224689e00`. Caught. Keep the maintained assertion. No follow-up.
